question: When is National Anti-Terrorism Day observed in India?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**May 21**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• National Anti-Terrorism Day: 21 May.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**National Anti-Terrorism Day** is observed on **May 21** every year in India.

 
 
• 
 
It commemorates the **assassination of Rajiv Gandhi**, India’s **youngest Prime Minister**.

 
 
• 
 
Rajiv Gandhi was **killed by an LTTE suicide bomber** on **May 21, 1991**, in **Sriperumbudur**, near Chennai.

 
 
• 
 
**VP Singh's government** declared this day to **raise awareness against terrorism** and to **honour Rajiv Gandhi**.

 
 
• 
 
**2025** marks the **34th death anniversary** of Rajiv Gandhi.

 
 
• 
 
**Vir Bhumi** in **New Delhi** is the memorial dedicated to him.

 
 
• 
 
Rajiv Gandhi served as **Prime Minister from 1984 to 1989**.
